_: Domestic cup fixtures, which the v2 fixture layer (38 league + 8 Champions League) never carried. One entry per tie as it is drawn; the build merges them into index.json in date order and the calendar counts what it holds rather than saying 46. A played cup tie gets a match payload the same way a league match does — run the ingest with --comp EFL.

fixtures.source: brightonandhovealbion.com, 'Albion head to Old Trafford in Carabao Cup' and 'Date confirmed for Carabao Cup tie against Manchester United' (retrieved 2026-09-08)
